module_role: Point-to-point single-drop sensor/actuator communication controller: an IO-Link (IEC 61131-9, SDCI) Master port or Device that drives the C/Q combined communication and switching line, switches between SIO (binary switching) and SDCI (UART communication) modes via a wake-up request, exchanges UART 8-E-1 octets at COM1/COM2/COM3 in M-sequences (CKT/CKS checksums), carries cyclic Process Data and acyclic On-request Data (ISDU Index/Subindex) and Events, and runs the STARTUP/PREOPERATE/OPERATE state machine via the MasterCommand.

integration_overview.host_bus_side: 8-bit data bus + 3 address pins + 3 chip-select pins + RD/WR strobes + optional ADS latch + INTR + DDIS bus-direction signal.
integration_overview.serial_side: SIN + SOUT for data; CTS/RTS/DSR/DTR/DCD/RI for modem handshaking; OUT1/OUT2 as user GPOs; TXRDY/RXRDY for DMA handshake.
integration_overview.clock_source: External crystal between XIN and XOUT, or external clock on XIN (≤ 24.0 MHz). Independent RCLK input for the receiver section if desired.
integration_overview.reset_source: Master Reset MR pin (active HIGH, Schmitt input, ≥ 1 µs).
integration_overview.interrupt_routing: Single INTR output (active HIGH) ORs all enabled sources.
integration_overview.clocking: asynchronous UART (local bit clock per end)

interfaces.signal: C/Q combined communication and switching line (0 V / 24 V)

interface_categories: Signal interface — single C/Q combined communication and switching line.
Power interface — L+ (24 V supply) and L- (ground) (three-wire interface).
Communication interface — UART 8-E-1 M-sequences (Process Data, On-request Data, Events).
Engineering interface — IODD (IO Device Description) for identification and parameterization.
interconnect_topologies_supported: Point-to-point Device -> Master port (one Device per port).
SIO operation (binary switching on the C/Q line).
SDCI operation (UART communication on the C/Q line).
default_signal_values_when_omitted: The Device powers up in SIO mode, so the C/Q line carries the binary switching value until an IO-Link Master issues a wake-up request and switches it into SDCI communication mode.
soc_dependent_items: COM rate (COM1 = 4.8 kbaud, COM2 = 38.4 kbaud, COM3 = 230.4 kbaud).
Process Data In / Out lengths (up to 32 bytes each).

low_power_modes.Standby: Not formally defined; ICC max 15 mA at 5.5 V; reducing XIN frequency reduces dynamic current.

compatibility_notes: Pin-for-pin compatible with 16450 except pins 24 (TXRDY) and 29 (RXRDY) which replace 16450's CSOUT and NC.
Software-compatible with 16450 after reset (FCR0=0 forces 16450 mode).
Setting FCR0=1 enters FIFO mode (16-byte RX/TX FIFOs).
topology_description: Point-to-point: one IO-Link Device connects to one port of an IO-Link Master over a single three-wire cable (L+, L-, C/Q), max 20 m. The Master provides multiple independent ports; each port drives exactly one Device. No bus, no multi-drop, no on-wire Device addressing.
device_classes_examples: IO-Link Device (smart sensor / actuator) — communication slave
IO-Link Master port controller — communication master
